caption: The drawing features a symmetrical vertical composition with distinct folk art motifs in various colors on a plain, cream-colored background. At the top, there is a stylized bird with a green body, red crest, yellow legs, and a tail composed of zigzag patterns in green, yellow, and red. The bird is perched on a thin, yellow vertical stem. Below the bird, two pink oval shapes, resembling leaves or petals, diverge outward from the stem. Further down, two blue wing-like shapes extend symmetrically from each side. In the center, there is an open, stylized urn or vase-like form outlined in pink, containing a yellow and blue flower. Two brown, star-shaped flowers flank the vase on either side. Below the central motif, two yellow leaves and a blue, petal-like shape are aligned with the vertical stem, positioned near the bottom of the composition. The artwork is signed and labeled in red in the lower right corner.
title: Design from a Proposed Portfolio
